title: Gut microbiota and aortic aneurysm/dissection: a two-sample Mendelian randomization study with independent replication
description: Analysis code and summary result tables for a two-sample Mendelian randomization study of 140 gut bacterial taxa and four aortic outcomes, with independent replication of abdominal aortic aneurysm in AAAgen. The repository contains the main MR/sensitivity scripts, figure scripts, harmonised exposure data, derived result tables, and the additional tables used in the manuscript. Raw FinnGen and AAAgen summary statistics are not included; download locations are given in the README.
